Publish components to your organization's registry, and install and manage registry components in a
project.

A registry component is named <publisher>/<name>, such as acme/wheel-picker: the publisher is your
organization's namespace ('voidhash registry publisher show'). Every project of the organization can
install what the registry holds.

Usage:
  voidhash registry <command> [flags]

Commands:
  list       List the project's components, its installs, and your organization's registry.
  publish    Publish a component bundle, or a ready project component, to your organization's
             registry.
  install    Install a component from your organization's registry.
  update     Update an installed component to the newest version in its range.
  uninstall  Remove an installed component from the project.
  deprecate  Deprecate a component or one of its versions.
  yank       Yank a component version for good.
  transfer   Move a component to another project of your organization.
  publisher  Show or claim the namespace your organization publishes components under.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash registry <command> --help' for more about a command.
